primary_market: Antwerpen en relevante servicegebieden in Vlaanderen
business_goal: Grow qualified organic demand for renovation projects while also becoming visible to architects, interior designers, property investors and other professional partners looking for a reliable renovation/construction execution partner.
operating_principle: Do not optimize only for people already searching for badkamerrenovatie Antwerpen. Build demand capture across direct service intent, problem awareness, investment intent, project planning and B2B partner/contractor discovery.

keyword_layers.purpose: Capture users already looking for renovation execution.
Reach people who feel the problem but do not yet know renovation is the solution.
keyword_layers.content_rule: Map problem -> symptom -> possible renovation solution -> relevant service -> local/commercial page -> lead. Do not force renovation as the answer when diagnosis or another specialist may be needed.

keyword_layers.purpose: Capture owners, landlords, investors and developers who treat renovation as an asset/investment decision.
keyword_layers.claim_rule: Do not invent ROI, resale uplift, rental uplift, payback or exact financial outcomes. Use current evidence or frame as factors/considerations.

keyword_layers.purpose: Capture users before they select a contractor.
Build discoverability for architects, interieurarchitecten, interior designers, designers and project professionals looking for execution partners.
keyword_layers.page_intent: Professional collaboration / execution partner page. Explain process, communication, planning, execution scope, drawings/specifications workflow and handover without claiming credentials or capacities that are not verified.

keyword_layers.purpose: Capture broader searches from clients or professionals looking for a contractor/construction partner even when they do not use the word renovation.
keyword_layers.relevance_rule: Do not target new-build or services Reno Rangers does not actually perform merely because GSC impressions exist. Keep business fit above raw volume.

keyword_layers.purpose: Combine service/project intent with real service areas and project types.

evidence_priority: Antwerp local Google Ads Keyword Planner demand
Belgium Keyword Planner demand for market breadth
existing page authority and cannibalization risk
selection_rule: The final tracked keyword set must be evidence-based. Seed examples are discovery inputs, not automatically approved primary targets. Promote terms only after GSC/Keyword Planner/business-fit review.
weekly_sprint_rule: A weekly sprint should focus on one coherent cluster but may contain several related meaningful tasks. Do not repeatedly optimize only bathroom pages while other high-value renovation, investment or B2B partner opportunities have evidence.
page_creation_rule: Create a new page only when evidence shows distinct intent not adequately served by an existing page, after cannibalization and internal-link review. New public URLs remain approval-gated before autonomous publishing.
